component.name: LunaTranslator
component.summary: Visual novel translator with text hooking, OCR and dictionaries

description.p: LunaTranslator extracts the text of running games and visual novels and shows translations in an overlay. This is the native Linux port.

ul.li: Text hooking of Windows games running under Wine or Proton
OCR of a screen region, clipboard and file input
Many online, offline and large language model translation engines
Text to speech, dictionary lookup and Anki export
